name: doc2md
description: Batch-convert Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV and PDF into clean GitHub-Flavored Markdown before the agent starts reading — one file, a list, or a whole folder at once. For when a pile of mixed-format documents is cheaper to normalise in one pass than to open one by one.
